text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a national-scale spatial land use cover change (LUCC) modeling study focused on Mexico. The study implements spatially explicit models at 1 km resolution, quantitatively evaluates model accuracy using multiple metrics (similarity index, figure of merit, allocation and quantity disagreement), and provides mapped LULC projections. The study includes quantitative comparison of ≥2 future scenarios, and spatially explicit outputs are presented. Thus, it meets all core inclusion criteria for a research paper focused on LULC prediction at the national scale.)
